descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92582 How it works 6-7; AC 6 · “If more is dictated into a box after assigning, only the new words are added when it's assigned again”. Mixed: stated part — Different patient gets the whole box and the first keeps its copy; words added after assigning are the only ones appended; our part — A to B to A, a rewritten box, an empty box assigned then filled (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S11 Re-assign rules on the server: same patient again, more words, another patient, empty box

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 Re-assign works: re-assigning a box to a different patient adds its text to the new patient's encounter note and leaves it in the first patient's note. … (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 6; TFA-92582 step 6)
  • T2 If more is dictated into a box after it was assigned, only the new words are added when it is assigned again. (TFA-92582 AC 6; TFA-92582 step 7)
  • U2 Each box has 'Assign to patient', which opens a patient picker. Assigning appends the box's text verbatim to the end of that patient's encounter note and marks the box as assigned. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 3; TFA-92582 steps 2-3)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Tim's API tests on the template-isolation account

When Cells: same patient + nothing new; same patient + words added at the end; different patient; A → B → A; box rewritten; empty box assigned then filled

Then Nothing new → chart unchanged; words added → only the new words appended; different patient → whole box on B, A keeps its copy, mark moves to B; empty box → marked, chart untouched, later words do go

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright API assertions on encounterNotes and assignedPatientId (U5, T2, U2 marked). The same tests also expect A → B → A to leave two copies on A and a rewritten box to be appended in full; those cells encode the app's choice for Q5, so a green run does not accept them. These two cells are the evidence for Q5(a) and Q5(b); S12 does not repeat them

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).
